Lemma
[Weighted higher pressure estimates] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0099 ↗ lem:chow-iv-pressure-gradient-regularity 1. ch29:29.10\group Pressure Estimates

For every $\alpha \in (0,1)$, uniformly for $t\le -1$, \[ \| v^{3/2}\| _{C^{2,\alpha }}+ \| \sqrt v\, \nabla ^2v\| _{C^\alpha }+ \| v^2\| _{C^{3,\alpha }}\le C(\alpha ). \]
